metadata.source: Glen Rock Public Records, Council Minutes & State Audits

controversies.title: Transition Away from State Health Benefits Plan (SHBP)
controversies.summary: Faced with steep 20%+ annual rate spikes imposed by the State Health Benefits Commission, Glen Rock negotiated a municipal exit from SHBP to join private insurance pools, saving taxpayers ~$450,000 annually while protecting employee healthcare networks.
controversies.outcome: Borough Council approved JIF membership with overwhelming bipartisan support.

controversies.title: State 2% Tax Cap Pressure & Low Foundation Aid ($3.7M)
controversies.summary: Under the NJ School Funding formula (SFRA), Glen Rock is categorized as high property wealth, receiving only ~6% of its $61.8M budget from Trenton. This forces local homeowners to shoulder nearly 89% of educational costs, creating annual structural challenges under the 2% cap.
controversies.outcome: District continues proactive state legislative advocacy and shared services.

controversies.title: Faber Field Athletic Complex Drainage & Turf Renovations
controversies.summary: Debates among residents regarding environmental safety, artificial turf vs. natural grass, and stormwater runoff mitigation along Diamond Brook resulted in comprehensive independent engineering reviews prior to municipal bond authorizations.
controversies.outcome: Environmental safeguards and enhanced stormwater detention basins incorporated into project bids.
